Description: ImHungry static React frontend on Amplify Hosting; authentication uses the existing Cognito pool.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Host built repository frontend without an additional server or GitHub credential.
must: Use public Cognito identifiers only; never embed private keys or credentials.

Properties.CustomHeaders:
customHeaders:
  - pattern: '**/*'
    headers:
      - key: X-Content-Type-Options
        value: nosniff
      - key: Referrer-Policy
        value: strict-origin-when-cross-origin
      - key: X-Frame-Options
        value: DENY
      - key: Content-Security-Policy
        value: "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://cognito-idp.us-west-2.amazonaws.com https://kud8sdryy0.execute-api.us-west-2.amazonaws.com; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'"

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Publish built static assets from this repository through repeatable manual deployment.
must: Deploy frontend/dist contents rather than the source directory.

FrontendOrigin.Description: Frontend URL and allowed backend CORS origin
